title: Efficacy of intravitreal ziv-aflibercept in patients with macular edema following retinal vein occlusion in Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital, Ghana: a retrospective case series

condition: Centre-involving macular edema (retinal thickness above 300 um) secondary to retinal vein occlusion, treatment-naive or untreated for 3 months, retrospective case series at Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital, Ghana (October 2016 to March 2018), 43 eyes of 42 patients with at least 6 months of follow-up

groups.description: Baseline diagnostic subgroup: branch retinal vein occlusion
Baseline diagnostic subgroup: central (16 eyes) or hemi-retinal (3 eyes) vein occlusion
